This exceptional 2020 Ferrari F8 Tributo Base represents a remarkable opportunity to own one of Ferrari's most celebrated modern creations, finished in striking gray with just 10,900 miles on the odometer.

- 3.9L V8 engine with 7-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive
- Ceramic disc brakes front and rear
- Adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent setup
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay integration
- Rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera
- Leather seat trim with front bucket seats
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Speed-sensing steering with sport steering wheel
- 20" alloy wheels
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Dual front impact airbags with side impact protection

The F8 Tributo delivers an engaging driving experience with its potent 3.9L V8 paired to a responsive 7-speed automatic transmission. The adaptive suspension system works seamlessly to balance performance and comfort, while the speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving inputs for precise control at any velocity. Real-world fuel economy registers at 15 city and 19 highway miles per gallon, reflecting the engine's efficient engineering.

Technology integration focuses on practical essentials, including a full navigation system and Apple CarPlay compatibility for smartphone connectivity. The backup camera and rear parking sensors provide confidence when maneuvering, while the automatic headlights and rain-sensing wipers contribute to safe operation in varying conditions.

The cabin offers authentic luxury through leather seat trim and a leather-wrapped steering wheel, complemented by climate zones that maintain individual comfort preferences. The sport steering wheel and telescoping adjustment allow customization to your driving position, while the trip computer and exterior temperature display keep essential information at your fingertips.

Safety features include ceramic disc brakes with ABS, dual front and side airbags, electronic stability and traction control systems, and tire pressure monitoring for comprehensive protection. The 20" alloy wheels provide both visual impact and responsive handling characteristics.

This F8 Tributo combines Ferrari's engineering heritage with modern practicality, offering collectors and enthusiasts a vehicle that performs as impressively as it looks. We invite you to experience this distinctive Italian sports car firsthand and discuss ownership options available through our showroom.

description: * Carbon Drive Zone * Daytona Style Seats *The 2012 Ferrari 458 Italia represents a defining chapter in Ferraris naturally aspirated V8 era, combining exceptional performance with remarkable precision and driver engagement. At its heart is a 4.5-liter naturally aspirated V8, mounted in a mid-rear configuration and producing 562 horsepower at 9,000 rpm and 398 lb/ft of torque at 6,000 rpm. With a soaring 9,000-rpm redline, the engine delivers the immediate throttle response and unmistakable high-revving character for which the 458 has become renowned.Power is delivered exclusively to the rear wheels through Ferraris 7-speed F1 dual-clutch transmission, providing exceptionally rapid gear changes while retaining the involvement of steering-column-mounted paddle shifters. The combination allows the 458 Italia to accelerate from 062 mph in under 3.4 seconds, with a top speed exceeding 202 mph. Perhaps most significant is the way the 458 Italia delivers its performance. Rather than relying on turbocharging, its naturally aspirated V8 builds power progressively toward its 9,000-rpm peak. Its performance extends well beyond straight-line speed. Developed using Ferraris extensive Formula One experience, the 458 incorporates an advanced E-Diff electronic differential, F1-Trac traction-control system, sophisticated magnetorheological suspension and a driver-selectable Manettino mounted on the steering wheel. These systems continuously manage traction, stability, damping and power delivery, allowing the chassis to exploit the performance of the V8 while providing exceptional balance and responsiveness.Options - Rosso Corsa exterior with a Beige hide interior, Adaptive Front-Lighting System, Red Brake Calipers, Carbon Fiber Driver Zone and LEDS, Carbon Fiber Central Bridge, Exterior Sill Kick in Carbon, Cruise Control, Daytona Style Seats, Electrically Operated Seats, Suspension Lifter, Heat Insulating Windscreen, Ferrari iPod, Cavallino Stitched into Headrests in Contrast Color and 'Scuderia Ferrari' Shields.This excellent example has covered just 18,792 miles since new and shows ownership history in Florida, (servicing completed by Ferrari of Fort Lauderdale) New York, (servicing completed by Ferrari of Long Island) New Jersey, (servicing completed by Ferrari of New Jersey) and Nevada, (servicing by Ferrari of Las Vegas). description: * JUST 11,740 MILES * FULL SERVICE COMPLETED MAY 2026 * The Aston Martin V12 Vanquish S holds the distinction of being the final completely hand built model offered by Aston Martin and the final production vehicle to be assembled at Newport Pagnell, prior to the Company moving to their new production facility at Gaydon.Production of the V12 Vanquish S was limited to just two years for the North American market, (2005 and 2006) and saw just 326 units delivered during those two years. For 2006, the interior design was reconfigured, following the design cues for the interface found on the new DB9 and allowed the incorporation of a standalone Navigation screen.Compared with the original V12 Vanquish which was produced between 2001 and 2004, the V12 Vanquish S saw subtle revisions to the nose shape, wheel design, a new raised boot lid and a small front splitter and was combined with Sports Dynamic Package that included stiffer suspension, revised steering and larger brakes. These changes were made to incorporate an increase in horsepower from 460hp to 520hp and torque from 400lb/ft to 426lb/ft. A change in gear ratios enabled a top speed of 200mph, (up from 190mph) and a 4.2 seconds 0-60mph sprint time, (0.3 seconds quicker than a non-S variant).This beautifully presented example was delivered to the first of its two owners since new in October 2006 and has remained a California car since new. Prior to offering for sale today, this V12 Vanquish S received a full annual service and four new tires to ensure that the next owner receives not only a cosmetically stunning vehicle, but one in excellent mechanical condition also. This Vanquish S is finished with a very well preserved Jet Black, (non-metallic) exterior over an interior finished in Sandstorm Connolly Leather with Obsidian Black Leather Seat Inserts, Obsidian Black Steering and Carpets. Complementing this is a light Ivory, quilted headliner.Other factory options include a 2+0 seating configuration, Bluetooth telephone preparation, body colored exterior door handles, red brake calipers, center console storage box and front stone guards.This 2006 Aston Martin V12 Vanquish S is offered for sale today with both keys and remotes, owners handbook and battery conditioner.

description:
!! 6-SPEED R-TRONIC MANUAL TRANSMISSION !! Step into the cockpit of this 2009 Audi R8 4.2 and feel the presence of a true mid-engine icon, finished in the dramatic Phantom Black Pearl Effect over Lava Gray. That deep, pearl-infused black catches the light with a metallic depth that shifts between shadow and brilliance, while the Lava Gray accent creates a sharp, modern contrast along the signature body-color side blades. Those sculpted blades frame the aggressive stance, emphasizing the R8’s low, wide proportions and the unmistakable mid-engine silhouette that still turns heads years later. Riding on 19-inch 5-arm double-spoke alloy wheels wrapped in staggered performance rubber—235/35R19 up front and 295/30R19 at the rear—the car sits planted and purposeful, ready to translate every input into pure theater.

Beneath the rear deck sits the heart of the machine: the 4.2-liter FSI V8, a high-revving naturally aspirated engine that delivers its power with a rising soundtrack that fills the cabin and the road behind you. Paired with the 6-speed R-Tronic transmission, it offers crisp, rapid shifts that keep the engine in its sweet spot whether you’re carving through traffic or stretching it out on an open stretch of pavement. Quattro all-wheel drive keeps the power locked to the ground with the confidence Audi engineered into every R8, giving this car the grip and balance that make it as usable as it is thrilling.

Inside, the black cabin is wrapped in fine Nappa leather across the sport bucket seats and door inserts, creating a tactile, driver-focused environment that feels both luxurious and purposeful. The heated sport seats cradle you for longer drives, while the Leather Package elevates the entire interior with soft, rich surfaces that contrast the technical precision of the dashboard. The Premium Package adds everyday refinement: Audi Hill Hold Assist makes stop-and-go traffic effortless, the storage package keeps essentials organized, auto-dimming heated and folding exterior mirrors manage glare and convenience, and the front-and-rear parking system with rearview camera simplifies maneuvering this wide, low supercar in tight spaces.

Technology is equally considered. The AM/FM stereo with CD, navigation, and Sirius Satellite Radio is joined by the Audi Navigation System Plus, delivering clear guidance and entertainment without interrupting the connection between driver and machine. Every detail—from the body-color side blades to the heated seats and leather door inserts—has been chosen to make this R8 feel special both on the road and in the garage.

This is the original R8 experience: a mid-engine V8 that revs freely, a transmission that responds instantly, and a design that still looks futuristic. Finished in Phantom Black Pearl Effect/Lava Gray with a black leather interior and the full suite of premium features, it invites you to drive it exactly as Audi intended—confidently, dramatically, and with a permanent grin.

description: 2020 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 // 6-Speed Manual // 21st Century Muscle Cars Heads & Cam Build // Satin Silver Wrap // Sold by AutoPark Dallas AutoPark Dallas is proud to present this absolutely INSANE 2020 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1, originally finished in Summit White and now wrapped in a gorgeous Satin Silver, featuring a professionally built 6.2L Supercharged LT4 V8 with an extensive HEADS & CAM PACKAGE by 21st Century Muscle Cars, paired with a proper 6-speed manual transmission and showing just 27,996 miles. GUYS... THIS MIGHT BE ONE OF THE SICKEST CAMAROS WE'VE EVER HAD. And if you know AutoPark Dallas, you know we've had our fair share of incredible performance cars. But every once in a while, something comes through our doors that makes us stop and say... MY GOD. SATIN SILVER. SUPERCHARGED LT4. HEADS & CAM. 6-SPEED MANUAL. BUILT BY 21ST CENTURY MUSCLE CARS. THIS IS THE REAL DEAL. Let's start with the appearance because this thing looks absolutely RIDICULOUS. Originally finished in Summit White, this ZL1 has been transformed with a Satin Silver exterior wrap, giving the car an aggressive, almost concept-car appearance. There's something about Satin Silver on a modern American muscle car that just WORKS. The finish highlights the Camaro's muscular body lines, aggressive front fascia, sculpted hood, and wide rear haunches without looking overly flashy. IT LOOKS LIKE SOMETHING THAT SHOULD HAVE COME STRAIGHT OUT OF A CHEVROLET PERFORMANCE DESIGN STUDIO. And while the exterior is incredible, the real story is what's underneath the hood. THIS IS NOT YOUR AVERAGE ZL1. From the factory, the sixth-generation Camaro ZL1 was already an absolute MONSTER. Chevrolet equipped these cars with the 6.2-liter Supercharged LT4 V8 producing 650 horsepower and 650 lb-ft of torque, making the ZL1 one of the most serious American performance cars of its era. But somebody decided that wasn't enough. ENTER 21ST CENTURY MUSCLE CARS. For those familiar with the Texas performance scene, 21st Century Muscle Cars is a recognized name in high-performance GM builds. And this ZL1 features an extensive heads-and-cam performance package from their shop. WE'RE NOT TALKING ABOUT A SIMPLE INTAKE AND EXHAUST. We're talking about a properly involved engine build featuring upgraded cylinder heads, a custom camshaft, valvetrain components, supercharger modifications, supporting hardware, and professional tuning. THIS IS THE KIND OF BUILD THAT GETS US EXCITED. The engine package includes Stage 2 ported LT4 cylinder heads, a 21st Century Muscle Cars custom camshaft with custom fuel lobes, upgraded dual valve springs and retainers, chromoly pushrods, high-performance lifters, and a phaser lockout kit. That is a serious amount of engine work. And to complement the internal upgrades, the supercharger system received additional attention. PORTED AND POLISHED SUPERCHARGER SNOUT. PORTED AND POLISHED THROTTLE BODY. LOWER SUPERCHARGER PULLEY. UPGRADED HARMONIC BALANCER. BILLET IDLER PULLEY. ROTO-FAB COLD AIR INTAKE. CHEF'S KISS. The combination is designed to improve airflow, support increased boost, and take advantage of the upgraded cylinder heads and camshaft. And of course, a build like this needs to sound the part. AMERICAN RACING HEADERS. This ZL1 features American Racing stainless steel long-tube headers paired with an American Racing stainless X-pipe with high-flow catalytic converters. Combine that with the custom camshaft and supercharged LT4, and you've got the ingredients for one seriously aggressive-sounding Camaro. THERE'S JUST SOMETHING ABOUT A CAMMED LT4. The idle, the supercharger whine, the exhaust note — it's exactly the kind of mechanical personality that makes a properly built American performance car so special. And here's one of our favorite parts. IT'S A 6-SPEED MANUAL. Not a paddle-shift automatic. Not a dual-clutch transmission. THREE PEDALS. A PROPER SHIFTER. AND A BUILT SUPERCHARGED V8. In an era where so many high-horsepower cars have moved away from manual transmissions, there's something incredibly satisfying about a build like this. The driver is completely involved in the experience. And that's exactly how we'd want a Camaro of this caliber. NOW LET'S TALK ABOUT WHERE THIS CAR CAME FROM. We purchased this ZL1 directly from a good friend of ours, which makes us even more excited to offer it. We know where the car came from, we know the story behind the build, and we have the details of the performance package installed by 21st Century Muscle Cars. That kind of familiarity means a lot to us when dealing with modified performance vehicles. THIS ISN'T SOME MYSTERY BUILD WITH A BUNCH OF RANDOM PARTS THROWN AT IT. The documented build specification identifies the engine components, supporting modifications, professional installation, and custom dyno and street tuning. And that's exactly what we like to see. The package also specifies a chassis dyno report covering horsepower, torque, and air/fuel ratio. We'd rather let the actual dyno documentation speak for the car's modified output than throw out some ridiculous horsepower number. THE BUILD SPEAKS FOR ITSELF. The coupe's low, wide stance gives it a commanding presence, while its understated black-on-black color combination allows the performance to speak for itself. Inside, the CTS-V offers a driver-focused cabin with premium black leather and suede upholstery, supportive sport bucket seats, and Hennessey-embroidered headrests. The interior features contrast stitching, a leather-wrapped multifunction steering wheel, polished sport pedals, a center-mounted infotainment system, and a power sunroof. Accompanying the vehicle is documentation from Hennessey Performance, including the original May 1, 2014 sales order and a signed Certificate of Authenticity identifying the vehicle as HPE700 build number 63. The paperwork confirms the performance conversion and details the extensive engine upgrades performed by Hennessey. Combining the distinctive styling of the second-generation CTS-V Coupe with the added exclusivity and performance of Hennessey build number 63, this Cadillac offers an outstanding combination of American luxury, supercharged horsepower, and collector appeal. The 2026 Mercedes-AMG CLE 53 4MATIC+ Coupe is what happens when a graceful grand-touring coupe gets a serious dose of AMG attitude. Finished in MANUFAKTUR Moonlight White Metallic and hovering around the 4,900-mile mark, this CLE pairs a 443-horsepower turbocharged inline-six with sculpted, wide-hipped styling and a cabin full of luxury and technology that feels like a private lounge. It also arrives with a clean story. CARFAX shows a single owner and no accidents or damage reported, the service history reads like a car that was looked after, and years of transferable Mercedes-Benz factory protection are still ahead of the next owner. Factory upgrades including Pinnacle Trim, the AMG Performance Studio Package, the AMG Night Package Plus and 20-inch AMG wheels mean this CLE is ready to turn heads from the first drive. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The CLE is Mercedes-Benz's modern take on the classic two-door coupe, and the AMG 53 is the one for drivers who want more than good looks. It goes up against the BMW M440i and the Audi S5, and it answers with a quiet, beautifully finished cabin, a long list of standard technology, standard all-wheel drive and real AMG performance that is ready whenever you are. Compared with the standard CLE, the AMG 53 adds wider fenders, a wider track, rear-axle steering and a sport-tuned suspension for sharper, more confident handling. For buyers who want the style of a coupe without giving up daily usability, the CLE delivers a 113.2-inch wheelbase that gives the cabin real room, a power trunk for easy loading and a technology package that ranks among the best in the class. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have been consistently warm toward the CLE lineup. Edmunds scored it 8.0 out of 10 and rated it Excellent, praising its smooth, strong and quiet six-cylinder engine, standard all-wheel drive, attractive styling inside and out, infotainment and technology that rank among the best available, and handling that is better than its weight suggests. Edmunds scored its in-cabin tech and X factor at 9 out of 10 each. Motor Authority noted that the CLE 53's 443-horsepower mild-hybrid inline-six sends power to all four wheels, and that Mercedes claims a 0-to-60-mph time of 4.0 seconds. WARRANTY The odometer currently reads 4,945 miles. This CLE is STILL COVERED by transferable Mercedes-Benz factory warranty protection, measured from an estimated in-service date of September 2025. Service records reported to CARFAX show regular maintenance at a Mercedes-Benz dealership, including an oil and filter change in June 2026 and a maintenance inspection in August 2026. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty: 4 years or 50,000 miles, whichever comes first, running through September 2029 with approximately 45,055 miles remaining. This covers defects in materials and factory workmanship, including comprehensive powertrain coverage. Corrosion perforation coverage and Roadside Assistance are also included with the factory warranty. Extended service plans are available for owners who want protection beyond these factory terms. STANDARD FEATURES The AMG CLE 53 starts where other coupes stop. It comes standard with an AMG-enhanced 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six with mild-hybrid assist, a nine-speed automatic transmission, AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive, rear-axle steering, sport-tuned adaptive suspension, a 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster, an 11.9-inch center touchscreen with navigation, a panoramic sliding sunroof and a 15-speaker audio system. It also layers in the details that make an AMG feel special: MB-Tex and microfiber upholstery with red stitching, a power trunk, HomeLink, an aerial view camera system, a driver monitoring alert and a long list of driver-assistance and safety technology. INSTALLED OPTIONS This CLE was ordered with three desirable packages and a handful of high-value extras, which lifts it well above a typical CLE 53. Pinnacle Trim Head-up display Projects key information into the driver's line of sight so eyes stay on the road. DIGITAL LIGHT with projections Advanced headlight technology that adapts to the road and can project helpful visual cues. MBUX Augmented Reality for Navigation Overlays directional guidance on a live camera view for easier turns. AMG Performance Studio Package Rear diffuser and larger rear spoiler Add a more aggressive, race-inspired look to the rear of the coupe. AMG Night Package Plus Blacked-out exterior accents Give the CLE a sleek, stealthy, more aggressive appearance. Standalone Features 20-inch AMG black multi-spoke Y-design wheels Fill the wide fenders and add a bold, sporty stance. MANUFAKTUR Moonlight White Metallic paint A rich, luminous white that shows off the CLE's sculpted lines. Natural grain black wood trim with aluminum lines Adds warmth and an upscale look to the cabin. Heated steering wheel Warms the wheel on cold mornings. Dashcam Records the road ahead for added peace of mind. AMG fuel filler cap A small AMG detail that adds to the car's sporty character. Metal weave center console Adds a distinctive, modern accent to the cabin. MECHANICAL FEATURES Under the hood is a 3.0-liter turbocharged inline-six with mild-hybrid assist that delivers 443 horsepower and 413 lb-ft of torque. A 48-volt hybrid starter generator and an electric auxiliary compressor sharpen throttle response and can briefly boost torque, giving the CLE an immediate, muscular feel from a stop and effortless passing power on the highway. Its mid-mounted engine and performance exhaust deliver impressive power and sound, while driver-adjustable ride control allows for customization. The limited-slip rear differential, cylinder deactivation, and a tuned sport suspension complete the package, ensuring exceptional agility and responsiveness on the road or track.

Unique Motors is pleased to offer this 2011 Cadillac CTS-V Coupe, finished in stunning Crystal Red Tintcoat over an Ebony interior. Combining aggressive American muscle car performance with Cadillac luxury, the second-generation CTS-V Coupe remains one of the most distinctive high-performance coupes of its era.

Powered by a supercharged 6.2L LSA V8 producing 556 horsepower and 551 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission, the CTS-V delivers exceptional acceleration, impressive handling, and the unmistakable character of a supercharged American V8.

With its aggressive two-door styling, rear-wheel-drive platform, Brembo performance brakes, and Magnetic Ride Control suspension, the CTS-V Coupe was engineered to compete with some of the world's most respected European performance vehicles.

Supercharged LSA V8 Performance

At the heart of the CTS-V Coupe is General Motors' legendary 6.2L LSA supercharged V8, an engine developed to deliver exceptional power while maintaining everyday drivability.

Producing 556 horsepower and 551 lb-ft of torque, the LSA provides immediate throttle response, strong midrange acceleration, and an unmistakable supercharged V8 soundtrack.

The CTS-V's performance engineering extends beyond the engine. Its Magnetic Ride Control suspension continuously adjusts damping characteristics to optimize handling and ride quality, while the Brembo braking system provides substantial stopping power.

The rear-wheel-drive chassis and limited-slip differential further enhance the driving experience, making the CTS-V Coupe equally capable of comfortable highway cruising and spirited performance driving.

The factory silver multi-spoke wheels complement the rich red exterior, while the signature vertical lighting and angular rear design distinguish the CTS-V Coupe from traditional luxury performance cars.

Inside, the Ebony / Ebony interior features a driver-focused cockpit with premium materials, supportive sport seating, and Cadillac's luxury appointments.

The 2011 Cadillac CTS-V Coupe represents an exciting era of American performance engineering, combining a factory-supercharged V8 with a sophisticated chassis and distinctive luxury coupe styling.

With 556 horsepower, 551 lb-ft of torque, Brembo brakes, Magnetic Ride Control, and rear-wheel drive, the CTS-V delivers serious performance while maintaining the comfort and practicality expected from Cadillac.

What makes this example particularly appealing is its striking Crystal Red Tintcoat exterior, Ebony interior, factory supercharged LSA V8, and 6-speed automatic transmission.

For enthusiasts seeking a powerful American luxury coupe with unmistakable styling and an increasingly uncommon supercharged V8 driving experience, this CTS-V is an excellent choice.

The long hood, low seating position, and short rear deck are consistent with the model's design, while the body includes functional openings and vents that serve the car's cooling and aerodynamic needs. The overall presentation is clean and direct, with the details shaped by the requirements of speed, stability, and heat management rather than decorative excess.

Inside, this Corvette Z06 carries a cabin arranged for two occupants, with leather seats fitted to the interior. The driving position is low and centered, with controls placed within easy reach of the driver. This example also includes a Head Up Display, which places key information in the driver's line of sight, along with push start for engine activation. Power seats are included as well, allowing for adjustment through electric controls instead of manual levers. Automatic climate control is part of the equipment list, adding a temperature-management system that operates without constant input from the occupants. The interior materials and switchgear follow the car's performance-oriented character, but the space still includes the comfort and convenience items listed here in a straightforward and usable way.

This Chevrolet retains the familiar Corvette profile while adding the Z06-specific bodywork that supports its higher-performance role. The panel fit, glass area, and overall stance all reflect a car that was developed around function first, with appearance following that intent.

Underneath the styling, this 2007 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is known for its 7.0-liter LS7 V8, a naturally aspirated engine that delivers substantial output and a strong mechanical character. The drivetrain is paired with a manual transmission in standard Z06 form, and the car was built with track-capable components that separate it from lesser Corvette variants. Brembo brakes, a rigid chassis, and performance-tuned suspension hardware are part of the model's core engineering, contributing to its braking and cornering ability. The Z06 was also equipped from the factory with wider tires and wheels than the base car, and those components are sized to support the power and grip expected from the model. This particular example combines that hardware with the listed conveniences, including leather seats, xenon headlights, automatic climate control, push start, power seats, and the Head Up Display.

description: 2012 Dodge Challenger Demon Edition — Mr. Norm’s, No. 8 of 12 The 2012 Dodge Challenger Demon Edition by Mr. Norm’s is a special-edition muscle car that combines the aggressive styling of the modern Dodge Challenger with the legendary performance heritage of Mr. Norm’s Grand Spaulding Dodge, a name long associated with high-performance Mopar vehicles. As Edition 8 of only 12, this car carries a particularly distinctive identity. Its limited-edition designation makes it stand apart from an ordinary Challenger and adds to its appeal for collectors of rare American muscle cars and enthusiasts of Mr. Norm’s automotive legacy. The 2012 Challenger's bold, retro-inspired design pays tribute to the classic Dodge muscle cars of the late 1960s and early 1970s. Its long hood, wide stance, muscular body lines, and unmistakable Challenger profile give it a commanding presence. The Mr. Norm’s Demon Edition name evokes the spirit of the original Dodge Dart Demon and the high-performance Mopar tradition that helped define an era of American automotive history. A rare piece of modern Mopar history The Mr. Norm’s Demon Challenger is more than a styling package, examples of this limited series were custom-built in collaboration with Bosak Performance. A documented example was finished in Redline Red Pearlcoat and advertised as one of only 12 sequentially VIN-numbered cars. JamesEdition With its exclusive numbering, unmistakable muscle-car character, and connection to the legendary Mr. Norm Kraus, No. 8 of 12 represents a rare opportunity to own a distinctive chapter of modern Mopar history. Its true collector appeal rests on the authenticity of its Mr. Norm’s build, its documented production number, and the condition and originality of the individual car. Important distinction: This is the Mr. Norm’s-modified Challenger, not the factory-produced 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon. The specific engine, horsepower, color, and modifications on No. 8 should be verified from its build records and identification plate rather than assumed from the Demon name.
